items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: That was Bob Dorough’s baby... Dorough is a particular hero of mine. [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. you guys have collaborated a number of times.

ctx.x: Right. That’s really interesting. Oh and I see a little later on you also did some stuff for “Schoolhouse Rock,” which was a great show.

That was Bob Dorough’s baby. Somebody thought the idea up but Dorough contributed the musical thing. He was the musical director and it was the stamp of Bob Dorough that made that show what it was. That and the great artwork. Dorough is a particular hero of mine.
Yeah, you guys have collaborated a number of times.
